ruleText.dice: Tap roll, read the result, and pass the turn if you are using it as a group decider. Use it for quick choices, penalties, or tie breakers.
ruleText.liarsDice: Each player rolls privately, then claims what dice are on the table. Raise the claim or challenge the previous player. If the challenge is right, the claimant loses a die; otherwise the challenger does.
ruleText.kollekt: Start the Kollekt game and play through household-based rounds. The app uses your shared stats to create prompts, points, and small challenges for the group.
ruleText.spinTheWheel: Add the people or options you want on the wheel, then spin. Whoever or whatever the wheel lands on is chosen for the next task, turn, or challenge.
ruleText.promptRelay: Join the same room and take turns adding to a shared story. Each player reads the previous line and continues it. Keep going until the story is finished.
ruleText.hundredQuestions: Read each question and point to the person who fits it best. Count votes out loud, discuss the result, then move to the next card.
ruleText.truthOrChug: Pick a numbered card. Either answer honestly or take the challenge instead. The group decides how strict the penalties are before starting.
ruleText.neverHaveIEver: Read the statement aloud. Anyone who has done it takes the agreed penalty. After the reactions settle, continue to the next card.
ruleText.kingsCommands: Draw one card and read the command aloud. The whole table follows it together. Anyone who can't — or won't — takes the drink penalty: 2 on Chill and Medium, 3 on Spicy.
ruleText.mexican: Roll secretly and announce a result higher than the previous player. The next player can believe you and roll, or challenge. A wrong challenge loses.
ruleText.kingsCup: Draw cards in turn. Each card rank has a rule. Follow the rule, keep the pace moving, and agree before starting what happens when the final king appears.
ruleText.categories: A category appears and players answer in turn before time runs out. Repeats, wrong answers, or silence knock a player out. Last player remaining wins.
ruleText.charades: One player acts without speaking while the others guess. Score the round when someone guesses correctly, then pass the acting turn to the next player.
ruleText.snusboksen: Pass the can around. When it's your turn, flip a card, read it out loud, and everyone points to whoever fits best. Then pass the can on.
ruleText.whoAreWe: Draw a card and read it out loud. Everyone points to the person they think fits best. That person can agree, disagree, or share the real story. Keep the conversation going as long as you want before moving on. No right answers — just honest ones.
ruleText.guysNight: Flip a card and do what it says. Mix of never have I ever, pointing rounds, dares, and drinking rules. Pick Chill to warm up, Spicy when the night gets going.
ruleText.girlsNight: Flip a card and do what it says. Mix of never have I ever, pointing rounds, dares, and drinking rules. Chill to ease in, Spicy when the wine kicks in.

dice.hint: Tap the die or the button to roll again.

liarsDice.rules: Roll your dice privately, then make or challenge claims around the table. Ones are wild and count as the face being claimed. Lose a round, remove one die. No dice means you are out.
liarsDice.tapCup: Tap the cup to reveal your roll.
liarsDice.wildHint: Ones are wild. The totals below include every one.
liarsDice.confirmDescription: Only remove a die when you lose a round. This cannot be undone for the current game.
liarsDice.outHint: You have no dice left. Start a new game when the table is ready.

mexican.rules: Roll in secret and announce a result. The next player must either challenge you or roll and announce a higher result. 21 is highest, followed by doubles and then regular rolls. Whoever loses a challenge takes your agreed penalty.
mexican.privateRoll: Only you should see this roll
mexican.lieResult: Bluff caught: {{previous}} rolled {{roll}}. {{previous}} loses the round.
mexican.truthResult: The claim held up: {{previous}} rolled {{roll}}. {{challenger}} loses the round.

kings.ready: Draw the first card when everyone is ready.

A.title: Waterfall
A.rule: Everyone loses a point, all at once — no exceptions.

2.title: You
2.rule: {{player}} chooses someone to lose two points.

4.title: Floor
4.rule: Last person to touch the floor loses a point.

5.title: Guys
5.rule: Everyone who identifies as a guy loses a point.

6.title: Girls
6.rule: Everyone who identifies as a girl loses a point.

7.title: Heaven
7.rule: Last person to point upward loses a point.

8.title: Mate
8.rule: {{player}} picks a mate. Whenever one loses a point, both lose a point.

9.title: Rhyme
9.rule: {{player}} says a word. Go around with rhymes; the first miss loses.

10.title: Category
10.rule: {{player}} picks a category. Go around the group; the first miss loses.

J.title: Never have I ever
J.rule: {{player}} says «Never have I ever …». Anyone who has done it loses a point.

Q.title: Question master
Q.rule: Answer a question from {{player}} or lose a point. This lasts until the next queen.

K.title: King's cup
K.rule: Add a point to the pot. Whoever draws the fourth king loses all the pooled points.

categoriesGame.rules: Name something in the category before time runs out, then pass the turn. A repeat, wrong answer, or timeout knocks you out. Last player standing wins.

charadesGame.passPhone: Pass the phone to {{player}}. Only the actor should see the card.
